about: Known accessibility debt (qa10). Each entry: an axe rule id, the page key from a11y.spec.ts, and a TODO. A listed rule does not fail the check on that page only; every other serious or critical problem still does. Remove an entry once it is fixed; the test run adds an 'allowlist-entry-now-passes' note when one already passes. Colour fixes are design changes for the owner to approve, so they are listed here instead of being changed by the test work.
